authority: User explicitly rejected enlarged cropped monster-token main art and authorized regenerated illustrations
scope: Auxiliary independent visual acceptance; upstream role JSON schemas and pinned algorithms remain unchanged

hard_checks.fail_if: The main monster image is a magnified or cropped printed token scan, with visible numeral/icon/rim fragments or the same rejected scan presentation
Essential anatomy or weapons are accidentally cut off, framing feels cramped or arbitrary, or the subject is distorted to fill the rectangle
Necessary enemy values or abilities, player resources or important controls are missing, hidden, overlapped, or ellipsized; include three-enemy states
Canvas differs from 1920x1080, the whole interface is shrunk, or readability/density is sacrificed to obtain an apparent optimization
An illustration is claimed as an in-game improvement without actual imported Unity screenshots showing that monster ID using it

decision: Any observed hard failure means failed, even if subjective scores are high. Missing relevant evidence means unverified. Do not average a hard failure away.

comparison.previous: Previous recorded version in the same fixture and display mode
comparison.limit: Different fixtures/modes cannot prove cross-version improvement; standalone art cannot prove UI integration

known_negative_controls: round08/ranged main art is cropped printed-token presentation
round07 and round08 three-enemy images truncate poison-assassin ability
history: Rounds1-8 and all previous scores remain archived unchanged; their strategy is now explicitly rejected by the user, not retroactively counted as successful art optimization
